findings.highlight: economics department
findings.evidenceJa: 商学部
findings.explanation: 商学部 is the faculty or department of commerce/business, not economics. This is the first statement of Shouko's claimed academic affiliation.
findings.japanese:
「う～ん、商学部ってもともと学生多いしねぇ。
学生課に聞いてみたらどうかな？」
findings.todokanai: "Hmm, we have a lot of students in the economics department. Maybe you could try asking at the Student Affairs office?"

findings.highlight: she's just not here
findings.evidenceJa: だったらいないに決まってるじゃない
findings.explanation: After Student Affairs reports that no one by that name exists, the reply concludes that the person does not exist there. 'Not here' instead suggests a temporary absence and weakens the clue that Shouko supplied a false identity.
findings.japanese: 「だったらいないに決まってるじゃない」
findings.todokanai: "Then that just means she's just not here, doesn't it?"

findings.highlight: economics department student
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに商学部だって
findings.explanation: The dialogue repeats commerce/business as Shouko's claimed faculty. Rendering it as economics repeats the same false concrete affiliation.
findings.japanese: 「でも…確かに商学部だって、本人が…」
findings.todokanai: "Still… she told me she was an economics department student herself…"

findings.highlight: Now that the thesis review was finished, the professors and upperclassmen all returned to the bustling Ogishima lab, making thesis recital their next goal.
findings.evidenceJa:
論文レビューも終わり、教授も先輩たちも戻り、
卒論発表会に向けてにわかに活気を取り戻した荻島研。
findings.explanation: A thesis presentation is called a recital.
findings.japanese:
論文レビューも終わり、教授も先輩たちも戻り、
卒論発表会に向けてにわかに活気を取り戻した荻島研。
findings.todokanai: Now that the thesis review was finished, the professors and upperclassmen all returned to the bustling Ogishima lab, making thesis recital their next goal.

findings.highlight: "No matter how hard you try to cheer me on, I'll still feel pain when my feelings are hurt."
findings.evidenceJa:
「あまり意気に感じてくれても、
心苦しいっちゃぁ心苦しいんだけどね」
findings.explanation: 意気に感じる and 心苦しい are rendered as being cheered on and feeling hurt, flattening gratitude and guilty discomfort.
findings.japanese:
「あまり意気に感じてくれても、
心苦しいっちゃぁ心苦しいんだけどね」
findings.todokanai: "No matter how hard you try to cheer me on, I'll still feel pain when my feelings are hurt."

findings.highlight: university is just a place for me where I need to get enough credits to graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 大学ってのは、単位を取って卒業するだけの場所じゃない
findings.explanation: Io says university is not merely a place to earn credits and graduate. The translation omits the negation and asserts precisely the position she is rejecting.
findings.japanese:
「あたしにとって大学ってのは、
単位を取って卒業するだけの場所じゃないってこと」
findings.todokanai: "The way I see it, university is just a place for me where I need to get enough credits to graduate."

findings.highlight: a host on a TV show
findings.evidenceJa: 局アナになってみせる
findings.explanation: Tomo intends to become a staff announcer for a broadcasting network or station. A TV-show host is a different occupation and changes the career goal for which she sought the pageant title.
findings.japanese:
「あんなものはただの足がかりに過ぎないの。
卒業したら局アナになってみせるんだから。
そのためにミス峰城取ったんだし」
findings.todokanai: "That's just a stepping stone. I want to become a host on a TV show after I graduate. That's why I fought for the title of Miss Houjou."

findings.highlight: doesn't even deserve pity
findings.evidenceJa: 蹴落とす価値もない
findings.explanation: Io says this woman is not even worth knocking down or defeating as a rival. The translation replaces competitive contempt with a judgment about whether she deserves pity.
findings.japanese:
「ふざけんじゃないわよ！
こんな女、蹴落とす価値もないじゃない！
どこまでも人のこと馬鹿にして…っ！」
findings.todokanai: "Don't screw around with me! A woman like you doesn't even deserve pity! Just how long do you plan to make a fool of me…!?"

findings.highlight: I don't ever want to stand in such a bright place again
findings.evidenceJa: もう二度と、あんな光の当たる場所には立てない
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she can no longer stand in that brightly lit place because it is too dazzling for her current self. The translation turns emotional incapacity and unworthiness into a voluntary preference not to return.
findings.japanese:
「もう二度と、
あんな光の当たる場所には立てない。
…今のわたしには、眩しすぎるから」
findings.todokanai: "I don't ever want to stand in such a bright place again… It's simply too blindingly bright for someone like me now."

findings.highlight: I find myself bowing very politely
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にだけは礼儀正しく深々と頭を下げた
findings.explanation: Koharu bows deeply and politely to Haruki. The translation makes Haruki perform the bow, reversing the actor in their first interaction.
findings.japanese: 何故だか俺にだけは礼儀正しく深々と頭を下げた。
findings.todokanai: I don't know why, but I find myself bowing very politely.

findings.highlight: I could clearly imagine the restaurant closing down
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が辞めると言った日の、終業後の様子が目に浮かんできた
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines what happened after work on the day he said he would quit. The translation invents the restaurant itself closing down, a materially different event.
findings.japanese:
なんとなく、俺が辞めると言った日の、
終業後の様子が目に浮かんできたような気がする…
findings.todokanai: For one reason or another, on the day I've decided to quit, I could clearly imagine the restaurant closing down…

findings.highlight: After it had failed on me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺のときもその手口だったし
findings.explanation: Haruki says the same tearful-pleading tactic had been used on him, with the context implying it worked. The translation explicitly says it failed, reversing the joke about an effective tactic being reused.
findings.japanese:
責任感の強い杉浦相手には、
きっと泣き落としが効果的な戦法だったんだろう。
…俺のときもその手口だったし。
findings.todokanai: Since Sugiura is so responsible, tearful pleading must have proved an effective strategy on her… After it had failed on me, that is.

findings.highlight: Congratulations on graduating
findings.evidenceJa: 合格おめでとう
findings.explanation: Haruki congratulates Sugiura on being accepted or passing the selection to receive his notes and role. The translation turns that local approval into graduation.
findings.japanese:
「そういう奴だから安心して託せるんだよ。
杉浦、合格おめでとう」
findings.todokanai: "I'll leave you my notes exactly because you're this type of person. Congratulations on graduating, Sugiura."

findings.highlight: "Come on, try saying it. Say that you hate people like me more than anything. …I've been waiting for you to say that for some time now."
findings.evidenceJa:
「ほら、言ってみなよ。
あんたなんか大嫌いだって。
…さっきからずっとその言葉を待ってるんだけどなぁ」
findings.explanation: Koharu's request to say 'I hate you' becomes 'I hate people like you,' broadening a direct rejection into a type judgment.
findings.japanese:
「ほら、言ってみなよ。
あんたなんか大嫌いだって。
…さっきからずっとその言葉を待ってるんだけどなぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Come on, try saying it. Say that you hate people like me more than anything. …I've been waiting for you to say that for some time now."

findings.highlight: one of the people who encouraged me strikes me with a glare, perhaps not hearing all that I just said
findings.evidenceJa: 励ましてくれた人の方をちらりと見たけど、どうやら本人には伝わっていないようだった
findings.explanation: Haruki glances toward the person who encouraged him, but she apparently does not realize that he means her. The translation invents her glaring and not hearing, reversing the gaze and deleting the missed recognition.
findings.japanese:
…と、励ましてくれた人の方をちらりと見たけど、
どうやら本人には伝わっていないようだった。
findings.todokanai: …And one of the people who encouraged me strikes me with a glare, perhaps not hearing all that I just said.

findings.highlight: I used up my savings and had to bow my head before my mother to ask for money
findings.evidenceJa: 貯金を切り崩してでも、母親に頭下げてでも
findings.explanation: Haruki says he must prioritize the matter even if that means dipping into savings or bowing to his mother. The translation reports both contingencies as completed facts.
findings.japanese:
だからしばらくは、貯金を切り崩してでも、
母親に頭下げてでも、優先させなくちゃならない。
findings.todokanai: That's why even though I used up my savings and had to bow my head before my mother to ask for money, I have to prioritize that thing above everything else.

findings.highlight: pretending that our relationship is great
findings.evidenceJa: 家族には深い関係みたいに装って
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she pretends to her family that the relationship is deep or serious. The translation substitutes the vague claim that the relationship is going well and loses both the audience and the nature of the deception.
findings.japanese:
「退屈でも我慢して夜遅くまで時間潰して、
飲みたくもないお酒まで飲んで、
酔って遅く帰って、家族には深い関係みたいに装って…」
findings.todokanai: "I endure the boredom and kill time until evening, drinking when I don't even want to, going home drunk, pretending that our relationship is great…"

findings.highlight: it's not too close or too far, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 当たらずとも遠からずなんじゃない？
findings.explanation: The idiom means the accusation is not exactly right but is not far off. The literalized English instead discusses physical distance and obscures the proposition.
findings.japanese:
「ま、当たらずとも遠からずなんじゃない？
さ、大通りまで出るわよ」
findings.todokanai: "Well, it's not too close or too far, right? Come on, let's walk to the main street."

findings.highlight: My wrist has become weaker
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の腕の衰え
findings.explanation: 腕 here is Haruki's skill or ability, paired with insufficient practice and fragile skin. The translation treats the idiom as a physically weakened wrist, changing his appraisal of his playing.
findings.japanese:
自分の腕の衰えと練習不足と皮膚の弱さ…
互いに相関関係のある、どれも情けない今の現実に
ため息をつくと、それが指先に触れてまた痛む。
findings.todokanai: My wrist has become weaker due to the lack of practice, and my skin has become more fragile… These factors put together make me realize the awful truth. I sigh once again and flinch in pain when air reaches my fingers.

findings.highlight: a side of Setsuna I've seen quite recently
findings.evidenceJa: 出会って間もない頃の
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes the troublesome phone voice from shortly after they first met. The translation says he saw it recently, reversing the callback's time and losing the return of an early-relationship Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
それは、出会って間もない頃の、
電話口だといつもの３倍くらいワガママになってしまう、
困った雪菜。
findings.todokanai: And that's when I realize this is a side of Setsuna I've seen quite recently; her troublesome side, one that's three times more selfish than usual, even over the phone.

findings.highlight: ever since New Year's Eve
findings.evidenceJa: 元旦の時以来
findings.explanation: The last occasion was New Year's Day, not New Year's Eve. The distinction matters because it identifies the post-midnight confession call.
findings.japanese:
だって、あの、元旦の時以来、
雪菜の声を聞くことができたんだから。
findings.todokanai: Because ever since New Year's Eve, I haven't once heard Setsuna's voice until now.

findings.highlight: The same Setsuna whom I so heartlessly destroyed.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が潰してしまった残酷な雪菜
findings.explanation: The source balances 'the pure Setsuna I stole' against 'the cruel Setsuna I crushed.' The translation makes heartlessness describe Haruki's manner and deletes the cruel aspect of Setsuna that had also been destroyed.
findings.japanese:
これが、かつて俺が奪ってしまった純粋な雪菜。
俺が潰してしまった残酷な雪菜。
findings.todokanai: This is the same Setsuna whose purity I stole. The same Setsuna whom I so heartlessly destroyed.

findings.highlight: I want her to be selfish. I want her to be self-centered. I want her to put me on the spot.
findings.evidenceJa:
ワガママを言われたい。
拗ねられたい。
困らされたい。
findings.explanation: Haruki's wish for Setsuna to sulk at him is reduced to his being self-centered.
findings.japanese:
ワガママを言われたい。
拗ねられたい。
困らされたい。
findings.todokanai: I want her to be selfish. I want her to be self-centered. I want her to put me on the spot.

findings.highlight: I absolutely… absolutely… won't hang up!
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対に、絶対に…切っちゃ嫌ぁ
findings.explanation: Setsuna pleads with Haruki not to hang up. The translation makes Setsuna declare that she herself will not hang up, reversing who controls the threatened action.
findings.japanese:
「信じられない…
絶対に、絶対に…切っちゃ嫌ぁ」
findings.todokanai: "I don't believe you… I absolutely… absolutely… won't hang up!"

findings.highlight: And I suppose that's about it.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、それだけだよ
findings.explanation: Haruki states with deliberate simplicity that loving Setsuna is all there is to it. 'I suppose that's about it' adds uncertainty and sounds dismissive, materially weakening the declaration.
findings.japanese:
「俺は、雪菜が大好きだ。
ただ、それだけだよ」
findings.todokanai: "I love you, Setsuna. And I suppose that's about it."
